name: fathom
description: A modern desktop client for Jellyfin, with an optional built-in YouTube player and Seerr requests.

paragraphs: An all-in-one client for Jellyfin, on desktop and Android. Your media, your server, Seerr requests, and YouTube, without leaving the app.
Coming to Apple devices: Fathom has no Mac or iPhone app yet, because building and testing them needs a Mac and an iPhone. Chip in on Ko-fi. Fathom stays free either way.

Fathom brings your whole Jellyfin setup into one window: movies, shows, music, and Live TV, plus most of Jellyfin's server-side management, so you rarely need the web dashboard. Two optional integrations, Seerr requests and a full YouTube client, live right inside the app. Everything plays through mpv (via mediakit / libmpv), so you get direct play, hardware decoding, and real subtitle and audio track control.
features: One player for everything. Jellyfin and YouTube share the same control bar, seek bar, speed control, track pickers, and keyboard shortcuts, plus a Playback Info overlay that shows codecs, resolution, and the live…
YouTube, built in (optional): search, subscriptions, local playlists, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, downloads, theater mode. No account, no ads.
Requests and ratings: Seerr browse-and-request with manage-in-place, plus Rotten Tomatoes, IMDb, and more.
Internet radio with live time-shift, casting, watch together over SyncPlay, picture-in-picture, and light / dark / AMOLED themes.

whatItDoes.text: An all-in-one client for Jellyfin, on desktop and Android. Your media, your server, Seerr requests, and YouTube, without leaving the app.
